channel.title: grokbot.dev - news
channel.description: Releases, deals, opportunities and platform updates for Grok Bot users.

item.title: Everything you need to know about Grok Bot templates
item.description: A Grok Bot template is a shareable blueprint for a Bot. Open one link and Grok Bot creates a new copy with the original role, skills, routines, and supported integrations. Your chats, logins, and secrets stay private.

item.title: Free month of Grok Bot for Lenny's Newsletter subscribers
item.description: Lenny Rachitsky is partnering with SpaceXAI - the first deal of its kind - to give every Lenny's Newsletter annual subscriber a free month of Grok Bot (included in Cursor Pro+). Existing subscribers redeem via Lenny's Product Pass; new subscribers get the link in their welcome email.
